scenario: LIMP.2.1.6 / LIMP.3.1.6 — no namespace packages. `import units` is a compile error when there is no `units.ds` (or in-memory `units` entry), even if `units/si.ds` exists. Each importable name must correspond to exactly one .ds file; pure grouping prefixes require an explicit `units.ds`. The `units/si.ds` is the standard library's own, on every fixture's search path ([RCTS.1.2.14]), which ships `stdlib/units/*.ds` and no `stdlib/units.ds`.
